snippet.title: Hades II - The Unseen Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Now in Early Access, Hades II is the bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler, and just got its third Major Update! It expands core combat, Guardian encounters, and the story, with lots of new visual flair!

Music: "Rock and a Hard Place" by Darren Korb feat. Erin Yvette, Ashley Barrett, and Judy Alice Lee, from the Hades II Original Soundtrack.

Play Hades II on Steam:  http://supergiant.games/hades2steam
Play Hades II on Epic Games Store: http://supergiant.games/hades2egs
